audience: agile teams who run retrospectives, standups and check-ins in Parabol

useCases.title: Start a retrospective, standup or check-in
useCases.text: Starts a new retrospective, async standup or check-in meeting for a team, with a name you choose, and returns the new meeting id.

useCases.title: Review past meetings of a team
useCases.text: Lists a team's meetings by type, newest first. For a retrospective, opens one to read its reflection groups, reflections and vote, topic and task counts.

useCases.title: Find tasks by team, person or status
useCases.text: Lists tasks filtered by team, user, status, archived state or a text query, so you can summarize what is active or stuck.

useCases.title: Create or update a task
useCases.text: Creates a task for a team with a status and text and an optional assignee, or changes the text, status or assignee of an existing task.

useCases.title: Add reflections and comments to a meeting
useCases.text: Adds a reflection card to a running retrospective, or a comment, including replies, to a meeting discussion.

useCases.title: See who is on a team and invite people
useCases.text: Lists a team's members with their lead and admin roles, then sends invitations to the email addresses you give.
